t: Core Vocabulary of Research Material Compatibility Database

description: Every field has its own language. These are the working terms of Research Material Compatibility Database — learn them first and every later record reads faster: compatibility: materials coexisting without degrading each other; PTFE: polytetrafluoroethylene, extremely chemically resistant polymer; galvanic corrosion: corrosion driven by dissimilar metals in contact; elastomer: elastic polymer used for seals.
definition: The working vocabulary of Research Material Compatibility Database: the terms practitioners actually use.
key_points: compatibility: materials coexisting without degrading each other
PTFE: polytetrafluoroethylene, extremely chemically resistant polymer
galvanic corrosion: corrosion driven by dissimilar metals in contact
elastomer: elastic polymer used for seals
passivation: protective oxide layer on metals like stainless steel
peroxide former: chemical that builds explosive peroxides on storage
